lessons.trigger_condition: an FX response is fetched now but has no trustworthy upstream observation timestamp, or persisted rates are non-finite, non-positive, stale, future-dated, or from an unapproved route/host pair
lessons.prevention_rule: accept currency conversion only when both collection time and upstream source timestamp are timezone-aware and fresh, route and host provenance match the allowlist, and every used rate and native amount is positive and finite; otherwise return zero conversion without inventing a rate or price
validation_required: fresh known-provenance rates with a fresh source timestamp convert normally
missing, stale, or future source timestamps fail closed
corrupt FX cache can be replaced only by a fully validated fresh upstream response
watched market-runtime change is covered by the exact candidate generation and exact base main
lessons.safety_boundary: do not refresh freshness from local fetch time alone, do not accept name-only market matches, do not generate placeholder prices, and do not claim physical Tablet or Drive verification
